title: Agentic Solution Engineer
text:
About the Company:

Netomi is the leading agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience. We work with the largest global brands like Delta Airlines, MetLife, MGM, United, and others to enable agentic automation at scale across the entire customer journey. Our no-code platform delivers the fastest time to market, lowest total cost of ownership, and simple, scalable management of AI agents for any CX use case. Backed by WndrCo, Y Combinator, and Index Ventures, we help enterprises drive efficiency, lower costs, and deliver higher quality customer experiences. 
Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us!
About the RoleNetomi is looking for a Solution Engineer - a key technical leader at the intersection of pre-sales engineering, AI architecture, and product innovation. This individual will design and implement agentic workflows that leverage the Netomi platform to power real-world enterprise solutions.

You’ll work directly with enterprise clients and internal stakeholders to translate visionary AI concepts into practical, scalable systems - enabling AI agents to engage, reason, and act autonomously within complex customer ecosystems.
Responsibilities

Partner with Account Executives to discover and scope customer challenges, designing high-value technical solutions that showcase the ROI of Netomi’s platform.

Architect and build agentic workflows that integrate generative AI with APIs, databases, and enterprise tools to power experiences for our customer’s end users.

Develop custom demonstrations, prototypes, and proofs of concept using the Netomi platform tailored to specific clients use cases.

Design, test, and refine prompts and AI orchestration chains to optimize performance, reasoning, and reliability across varied use cases.

Communicate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to audiences ranging from C-level executives to hands-on engineers.

Collaborate with product and engineering teams, contributing insights from customer engagements to inform roadmap priorities.

Document and present solution designs, workflows, and technical configurations for both internal and client-facing reference.

Requirements

1-2 years of experience in a customer-facing sales engineering or solutions engineering role, ideally in AI, automation, or enterprise SaaS.

Hands-on experience with AI prompt design, workflow orchestration, and integrating REST APIs, webhooks, and cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

Working knowledge of JavaScript, Python, or related scripting languages for building integrations and automation logic.

Proven ability to architect and communicate end-to-end technical solutions that align AI capabilities with business outcomes.

Functional understanding enterprise software ecosystems, and data flow patterns.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with a record of collaboration across technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in agentic or autonomous AI systems (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks).

Familiarity with MLOps, AI governance, and compliance in production-scale deployments.

Background working in high-growth startup environments.

Awareness of UX/UI principles for designing customer-facing AI experiences.

Netomi is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Junior Digital Innovation Engineer
text:
The Junior Digital Innovation Engineer supports the R&D team's mandate to explore and prototype emerging AI/ML capabilities, evaluate new technologies, and investigate improved software development approaches. Working under the guidance of the Team Lead and senior team members, the role conducts technology and literature scanning, assists in building proof-of-concept prototypes and feasibility spikes, documents findings clearly, and presents experiment results to the team. The role is expected to grow steadily in independence and technical scope as competence and confidence increase. 
Technology & Literature Scanning

Researches and tracks developments in AI/ML, emerging frameworks, and developer tooling relevant to the product and team's technology stack.

Summarises findings from articles, papers, vendor releases, and community sources into digestible internal notes.

Flags technologies, platforms, or techniques (e.g., new LLM capabilities, AI/ML frameworks, cloud AI services) that may warrant a deeper spike.

Maintains an up-to-date view of the broader industry landscape relevant to the team's exploration areas.
Assisting with Prototypes and Feasibility Spikes

Assists in building small-scale proofs-of-concept and feasibility spikes under the guidance of the Team Lead or senior team members.

Implements clearly-scoped experimental tasks using assigned frameworks, APIs, or platforms (e.g., LangChain, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face).

Sets up and tears down experimental environments in a controlled, low-risk manner.

Escalates technical blockers or scope uncertainty early rather than stalling on unclear experiments.
Documentation of Findings

Documents experiment setup, methodology, results, and conclusions clearly for each spike or proof-of-concept.

Records what worked, what did not, and why, to build the team's shared knowledge base.

Uses agreed tools (e.g., Confluence, Jira) consistently to track spikes and their outcomes.

Keeps documentation current as experiments evolve or are re-scoped.
Presenting Experiment Results

Presents proof-of-concept and spike outcomes to the team in a clear, structured manner.

Articulates what was tested, the results observed, and a recommendation on next steps (progress, pivot, or shelve).

Responds to questions from the Team Lead and peers about methodology and findings.

Builds confidence and clarity in presenting technical material as experience grows.
Ramp-Up and Learning Velocity

Actively works through onboarding materials, prior spike documentation, and internal knowledge bases.

Pairs frequently with the Team Lead and senior team members to build understanding of the innovation pipeline and evaluation framework.

Builds proficiency with the team's core AI/ML tools, frameworks, and experimentation practices.

Tracks own learning goals and progress with support from a mentor or the Team Lead.
Adherence to Experimentation Standards

Follows the team's defined spike/experiment process, tracking conventions, and documentation standards.

Uses agreed tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Git) consistently and correctly for tracking spikes.

Applies data-handling, security, and ethical-use guidelines when experimenting with AI/ML tools and third-party platforms.

Applies feedback from Team Lead and senior reviewers consistently in subsequent spikes.
Continuous Improvement and Feedback

Attends and engages in team retrospectives and knowledge-sharing sessions, offering observations even as a newer team member.

Acts on constructive feedback from the Team Lead and senior reviewers.

Reflects on own experiment outcomes and demonstrates visible improvement in technical judgement over time.

Builds toward taking on progressively larger and less-supervised exploration work.
Requirements

Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, OR a completed coding bootcamp / equivalent self-taught portfolio demonstrating comparable practical abi

title: AI Software Engineer
text:
About us
IOMETE is the sovereign data platform for the AI era. Enterprises run our data lakehouse, built on Apache Spark and Apache Iceberg, in their own trusted environment: on-premises, in their own cloud, or hybrid. It is built for regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare and government. Customer data never leaves the customer's trust perimeter, and the AI we build on it stays inside that perimeter too.
Position overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated AI Software Engineer to join our team. We tackle a variety of exciting challenges, from connecting AI tools and models to the lakehouse to diagnosing Spark applications and troubleshooting failures. You'll build agents that run inside the customer's environment, on LLMs the customer provides or, later, on custom models we train for Spark tuning and troubleshooting. You'll also build the framework that defines those agents and the harness that runs, limits, traces and evaluates them.
The AI team
We are building the AI platform for the lakehouse — Lakehouse Intelligence. The team's roadmap includes, but is not limited to, the MCP Server for AI Agents, which lets AI tools query the lakehouse; the Model Gateway, through which IOMETE's AI features call models; agents for Spark application diagnosis, troubleshooting and onboarding; and SQL AI Functions, which run language models from inside a query. Down the road, you'll also get to fine-tune and build custom models for our platform's specific needs, small enough to run inside a customer's deployment.
What you'll do

Contribute to and maintain IOMETE's AI services, including the MCP Server for AI Agents, the Model Gateway, SQL AI Functions, and lakehouse-specific agents (such as Spark Application Diagnosis) and their harness.

Build AI enablers: extend the IOMETE lakehouse and platform to support more AI-powered features, for example by making Spark job logs, query history and table metadata available to them.

Be hands-on with Kubernetes, including the Helm charts that ship our AI services into each customer's deployment.

Collaborate closely with external customer engineering teams to support integrations, troubleshoot complex issues and provide guidance for successful adoption of our platform.

Participate in design discussions about agents, model access, evaluation, and overall systems architecture.

Write the tests, docs and release notes for what you build. A feature is done when it has shipped with all of them.

Review your teammates' work and provide feedback.

What we're looking for

5+ years of professional experience in software engineering (we’re open to exceptional candidates with less experience who demonstrate deep systems knowledge and impact).

Deep understanding of LLM-based systems in production – tool calling, structured output, retrieval, evaluation, and how they fail.

Our AI features are written mostly in Python and Go. The data platform is built on the JVM, in Kotlin and Java, and new platform features are being built in Go. Production experience with any of these languages is a big plus, but we know strong engineers learn a new language fast.

Familiarity with distributed systems and their challenges (e.g., data consistency, fault tolerance, scheduling).

Fluency in English, both written and verbal — this role involves working with international customers and partners.

Based in a time zone that overlaps Amsterdam working hours (CET/CEST).

Preferred qualifications

Hands-on experience across the AI stack: agents and their evaluation, tool protocols such as MCP, model routing and serving, and fine-tuning.

Prior exposure to data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, etc.

Experience with Apache Spark (especially tuning Spark jobs), Apache Iceberg, or contributing to open-source compute engines.

Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Helm.

What we offer

Exciting projects and challenges.

Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology.

Ability to play a key role in shap

title: Frontend Engineer
text:
Welcome to Perena: Your Risk Layer on Solana
Perena is a decentralized financial protocol on Solana that offers USD STAR (USD*), a yield-bearing asset. USD* is fully collateralized and earns yield from diversified, real sources such as delta-neutral strategies and secured borrow-lend market positions. Its value grows automatically, making it a simple, secure way to save on-chain.
USD* is fully collateralized by a diversified portfolio of yield-generating assets and positions, including:
Delta-neutral hedged positions on centralized and decentralized exchanges (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL)
Secured borrow-lend market positions involving on-chain stablecoins
Real-world assets, such as the reinsurance fund by OnRe
Perena actively manages asset allocation and diversifies across multiple strategies to reduce single points of failure and optimize for sustainable, consistent yield performance.
Built on Solana's high-performance blockchain, Perena is creating a liquid, yield-bearing digital dollar that anyone can access with a sustainable, risk-managed approach.
Looking ahead, Perena is building a full suite of on-chain stablebanking products to expand access to real yield across crypto and traditional finance. The goal is a sustainable financial experience for anyone to transact, save, and invest on-chain.
Perena is founded by a team of builders from the Solana ecosystem with backgrounds in TradFi and DeFi. We believe deeply in pushing financial architecture forward — and in doing it with transparency, resilience, and speed.
We're backed by some of the best in the world, including:
Solana co-founders Anatoly Yakovenko and Raj Gokal
Investors from Citadel, Jane Street, IMC, and Susquehanna
Borderless Capital, Binance Labs, Primitive Ventures, Maelstrom, Anagram, Breed, and others

What We're Looking For

Industry: Recruitment & Headhunting

Location: Fully Remote (Open globally, including India, Pakistan, South Africa, LATAM, PH)

Job Status: Full Time / Contract

title: Software Engineer, ios
text:
Company Description
About Grab and Our Workplace
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Empowered by teamwork, we develop services and tools to serve millions across Southeast Asia. The payments team focuses on streamlining capabilities across multiple apps at PaySDK and looks for motivated iOS engineers for its mobile team.
Get to know the role
We are looking for experienced and enthusiastic iOS Engineers to join our team. You'll have the chance to contribute to the PaySDK, and multiple app clients like passenger, driver and merchant apps. Identifying problems and having the initiative and skills to solve them is crucial in this role Our team operates with advanced technologies like SwiftUI and RxSwift programming. title: CAD Engineer
text:

It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by phenomenal technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. We are now looking for Design Automation Tool development Engineers for our Tegra SOC development group. As the Lead, you will be responsible for architecting and crafting end-end tool flow to auto-generate system fabrics, sub-systems and SOC hierarchies, keeping user interface, maintainability and scalability in mind.

One should possess Strong software development skills and a dedication to high quality work. A proven track record to conceptualize, design and implement modular and robust EDA tools with well thought out APIs and interfaces would make you an excellent fit. Having a deep understanding of object oriented programming is a prerequisite for this role. If you have a zeal to make things better, we will have an excellent match for our needs.

What you’ll be doing:

Define next gen EDA workflows for the world's top chip designers and verification engineers.

Architect and develop tools, methodologies that bring AI in chip design cycle.

Analyze productivity bottlenecks, improve data analytics and visualizations of day-to-day workflows

Debug interesting, complex, and important problems that impact the team

What we need to see:

BS/MS in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience

2+ years of relevant work experience

Strong problem-solving abilities and a passion for debugging

Software architecture, development, & testing experience

Solid understanding of Linux and excellent coding skills (Perl/Python)

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

Exposure to RTL design/verification tools (VCS or equivalent simulation tools, debug tools like Verdi) and methodologies (UVM or equivalent)

Experience implementing scalable infrastructure solutions with frontend UX, RESTful APIs,  database, visualization, and backend automation.
